title: Self-Evolution Reasoner: Continuous Optimization via Policy-Intrinsic Exploration and Exploitation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34137v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enables large language models (LLMs) to continuously self-improve their reasoning capabilities. Compared to RLVR's scalar rewards, recent self-supervised on-policy distillation methods leverage denser supervision signals. However, both paradigms suffer from exploration bottlenecks, struggling to escape local optima when the policy fails to sample valid solutions. Relying on external demonstrations can bypass this issue; however, the off-policy nature hinders genuine self-improvement and the mismatched-distribution reasoning can not be fully exploited. In this work, we propose Self-Evolution Policy Optimization (SEPO), a framework that drives continuous reasoning capability evolution via guided exploration and in-distribution exploitation. translated_title: 自进化推理器：通过策略内在的探索与利用实现持续优化
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）使大型语言模型（LLM）能够持续自我提升其推理能力。与RLVR的标量奖励相比，近期的自监督在策略蒸馏方法利用了更密集的监督信号。然而，这两种范式都存在探索瓶颈，当策略无法采样到有效解时，难以摆脱局部最优。依赖外部演示虽然可以绕过这一问题，但其离策略的本质阻碍了真正的自我提升，且分布不匹配的推理无法被充分利用。在本工作中，我们提出了自进化策略优化（SEPO），这是一个通过引导性探索和分布内利用来驱动推理能力持续进化的框架。具体而言，SEPO利用标签从策略自身引出正确的推理，释放其探索潜力。通过将当前策略作……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出自进化策略优化（SEPO）框架，利用标签从策略自身引出正确推理以实现引导性探索和分布内利用，克服RLVR与自监督蒸馏方法固有的探索瓶颈，从而驱动大语言模型推理能力的持续自我进化。
en_tdlr: Proposes Self-Evolution Policy Optimization (SEPO), a framework that overcomes the exploration bottlenecks of RLVR and self-supervised on-policy distillation by using labels to elicit correct reasoning from the policy itself, enabling guided exploration and in-distribution exploitation for continuous evolution of LLM reasoning capabilities.
